transkript.t: This new quad plugin runs my Instagram for me,
making videos like this,
and it just pulled over 2.3 million views in two weeks.
Research, scripts, editing, posting, all of it,
and it's brand new, and you can even try it yourself.
And editing is the least impressive thing it does.
Making the video was never the hard part,
knowing what to make was,
but this makes both insanely easy.
It starts with research.
It studies the top accounts in your niche,
finds the videos that blew past their usual numbers
and shows you why they worked.
Then it rebuilds those ideas in your words,
your video style for your audience,
not a copy, your version,
based on specific ideal customers
you saved to your account.
You can use one of 100 different styles,
or create your own custom style in a few clicks.
Camera shy?
You don't have to show your face.
Every video you're seeing right now was made in seconds.
It all lives in one dashboard that runs on your own cloud,
which means no extra API credits to buy
or platform usage limits.
Track your growth from the mobile app,
and the more you post, the sharper it gets,
because it learns from your best performers.
You bring the product, the tools gets you users.
Wanna try it for yourself?
Just comment, rip, and I'll send you the tool.
